title: Compute a restricted Grassmannian secant rank

source.citation: Dalton Bidleman and Luke Oeding, Restricted Secant Varieties of Grassmannians, arXiv:2211.01469

translation.notes: The optimized cofactor construction of the 35-by-35 Pluecker Jacobian for sigma^1_2(Gr(3,7)) is translated directly. Three explicit deterministic witnesses replace the source's unseeded random specialization and all have the reported cone dimension 20.
